title: Simplify portfolio API routes for single-portfolio model
description:
Update API routes to work with single portfolio per user instead of multiple.

**Current Routes:**
- GET /api/portfolios - lists all user portfolios
- POST /api/portfolios - creates new portfolio
- GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/portfolios/[id] - individual portfolio ops

**Changes:**
- GET /api/portfolio (singular) - get user's portfolio (create if doesn't exist)
- PATCH /api/portfolio - update user's portfolio
- DELETE /api/portfolio - delete user's portfolio
- Remove list endpoint or redirect to single portfolio
- Consider auto-creating portfolio on first access

**Files:**
- app/api/portfolios/route.ts → app/api/portfolio/route.ts
- app/api/portfolios/[id]/route.ts - simplify or redirect
- app/api/portfolios/[id]/sections/route.ts → app/api/portfolio/sections/route.ts
- app/api/portfolios/[id]/html/route.ts → app/api/portfolio/html/route.ts

title: Phase 4: Media Upload & Management
description:
## Overview
Implement full media upload pipeline with Cloudflare R2 storage, including image/video processing and a media library UI.

## Tasks
- [ ] Set up Cloudflare R2 bucket and credentials
- [ ] Create presigned URL generation for direct uploads
- [ ] Build upload processing pipeline (thumbnails, optimization)
- [ ] Implement media library UI with grid view
- [ ] Add drag-and-drop upload support
- [ ] Create video player component with controls
- [ ] Add image optimization (resize, compress)
- [ ] Generate video thumbnails

## Technical Details

### R2 Upload Flow
1. Client requests presigned URL from API
2. Client uploads directly to R2
3. Webhook/callback triggers processing
4. Thumbnails generated, metadata stored in DB
5. Media appears in library

### API Endpoints Needed
- POST /api/media/upload-url - Get presigned URL
- POST /api/media/complete - Mark upload complete, trigger processing
- GET /api/media - List user's media
- DELETE /api/media/[id] - Remove media

### Processing Pipeline
- Images: Generate thumbnails (300px, 600px), compress original
- Videos: Extract thumbnail at 1s, store duration/dimensions

## Acceptance Criteria
- Drag files to upload area, see progress
- Images auto-optimize and generate thumbnails
- Videos extract thumbnail automatically
- Media library shows all uploads with filtering
- Can select media to add to portfolio sections

## Dependencies
- Requires R2 credentials configured
- Phase 1 database schema (media table exists)

title: Create API endpoint for batch element editing
description:
Create new API endpoint for batch AI editing:

Location: app/api/ai/edit-group/route.ts

Features:
- Accept GroupedAIEditRequest with multiple elements
- Build context-aware prompt that includes all elements
- Return structured response mapping selectors to new content
- Support streaming for progressive updates
- Handle both content-only and outer HTML replacements

Prompt strategy:
- Include all elements with their selectors in context
- Ask AI to maintain consistency across elements
- Return JSON mapping selector -> new content
- Consider rate limiting for large groups

Response format:
```json
{
  "edits": [
    { "selector": "...", "content": "...", "isOuterHtml": false },
    { "selector": "...", "content": "...", "isOuterHtml": true }
  ]
}
```

title: Phase 3: Interactive Portfolio Editor
description:
## Overview
Build a Lovable/v0-style interactive editing experience where users can click elements and describe changes to AI.

## Tasks
- [ ] Create selectable element overlay system
- [ ] Build AI edit panel with streaming responses
- [ ] Implement element-level editing with full portfolio context
- [ ] Add undo/redo history
- [ ] Create quick actions (rewrite, shorten, expand, change tone)
- [ ] Build visual section reordering (drag and drop)

## Technical Details

### AI Edit Request Structure
```typescript
interface AIEditRequest {
  elementPath: string;       // "sections[0].content.headline"
  currentValue: unknown;
  instruction: string;       // "Make this more professional"
  context: {
    fullPortfolio: PortfolioContent;
    userProfile: UserProfile;
  };
}
```

### Components Needed
- SelectableElement wrapper component
- EditPanel with instruction input
- HistoryProvider for undo/redo
- QuickActionBar for common edits

## Acceptance Criteria
- Click any text/element to select it
- Type instructions, see AI-generated changes stream in
- Accept or reject changes
- Undo/redo works reliably
- Quick actions provide instant common edits

## Dependencies
- Requires Phase 2 (AI Generation) for AI infrastructure

```typescript
}
```

title: Add batch element replacement to html-element-selector
description:
Update lib/editor/html-element-selector.ts with batch operations:

New functions needed:
- replaceMultipleElements(html, edits: Array<{selector, content, isOuterHtml}>) 
  - Apply multiple replacements in single pass
  - Handle selector invalidation (process in reverse DOM order)
  - Return updated HTML

- validateSelectors(html, selectors: string[])
  - Check all selectors still valid before batch edit
  - Return invalid selectors for error handling

Considerations:
- Replacing one element might shift positions of siblings
- Process replacements from bottom of DOM upward to avoid invalidation
- Or regenerate selectors after each replacement

title: Create data migration for existing multi-portfolio users
description:
Handle existing users who may have multiple portfolios before enforcing single-portfolio constraint.

**Migration Strategy:**
1. Identify users with multiple portfolios
2. Keep the most recently updated (or published) portfolio as primary
3. Archive or delete extra portfolios (decide policy)
4. Apply unique constraint after data is clean

**Considerations:**
- Backup strategy before migration
- Handle associated data (sections, contact_submissions, media)
- Log affected users for potential outreach
